Configuration saved.
Installed /handoff, which continues a session in another agent: ~/.claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md, ~/.agents/skills/handoff/SKILL.md
Installed the agent-archive skill, which lets your agents look up and pull in past sessions: ~/.claude/skills/agent-archive/SKILL.md, ~/.agents/skills/agent-archive/SKILL.md
To remove the agent skills and keep them off, run agent-archive setup --no-skills.

Next, in each app:
  Codex: start a supported new task in an included project; automatic discovery does not require hook approval.
  Optional hook capture: Codex: run /hooks and approve the archive hooks, then start a new session (or /clear).
  Claude Code: nothing to approve; start a new session (or /clear).
  Cursor: nothing to approve; start a new Agent chat.
Sessions already open are not captured. Start a new one in an included project.
Check progress with agent-archive status.

Looking for past sessions in these projects… none to import.

To set up another machine with this storage, run there:
  agent-archive setup --yes --provider s3 --bucket team-archive --aws-profile work --region us-east-1 --apps codex,claude,cursor --codex-discovery on --codex-capture-scope included-projects --prefix agent-archive/ --retention-days 30 --no-require-skill-use --skill-evidence metadata --skills --project ~/src/web-app --project ~/src/api
[exit 0]
